// one item per class meeting so 'Append Class' writes each row
return $input.first().json.rows.map(r => ({ json: { row: r } }));

parameters.content:
## UniPlan sub-workflow
- Set the spreadsheet ID + Google Sheets credential on the 5 Sheets nodes.
- Timezone for /next: edit TIMEZONE at the top of the Process Operation code node.
- 'Append Class' uses append-or-update on class_id so retries cannot create duplicates; /import feeds it one item per meeting.
- 'Mark Class Dropped' tombstones the row (user_id = __dropped__) – idempotent and safe against row-shift races.
- Errors bubble up to the main workflow, which notifies the user.
